Status.label: NEW
Status.meaning: First time this item has been seen.

Status.label: UPDATE
Status.meaning: Seen before but changed since the last run (the delta is shown).

Status.label: REPEATED
Status.meaning: The same story has recurred across 3 or more runs.

Status.label: DUPLICATE
Status.meaning: Identical to another item — stamped rank 0, shown collapsed, never emailed.

Glossary.label: Matched
Glossary.meaning: Item matched at least one glossary term, so it received a topic label.

Glossary.label: Gap — needs confirmation
Glossary.meaning: Rank 3 or higher but no glossary match — likely a term worth adding to the glossary.

Email.label: Unsent only
Email.meaning: Show only items that have not yet been sent in a digest email.
